title: Covenant Courier product delivery policy v1
description: Deterministic delivery policy evaluated by courier_deliver_v1.ps1 before any frame is sent. A message names a profile through covenant_courier.message.v1 policy_profile; an unknown profile is rejected (POLICY_PROFILE_UNKNOWN). Rule order is fixed: recipient node, session, payload size, payload encoding, restricted terms, Covenant Gate.

restricted_dictionary.description: Repository-relative courier.lexical_dictionary.v1; entries with sensitivity 'controlled' are restricted terms.

covenant_gate.description: off: not consulted. advisory: consulted when configured; a deny rejects, unavailable is recorded and local policy decides. required: an allow from Covenant Gate is needed; unavailable gives require_approval.

covenant_gate_signer.description: Principal whose ssh signature (namespace covenant-gate/decision) must cover a supplied decision document. Required to accept decision documents.
